practiceName: Full delivery loop smoke (own row; spans DG1, DG3, DG4, DG5, DG6)
title: Sign-in to blocked generation to recovery to review, approve, publish, and learner reveal
turnSequence: Sign in as amira.north@example.test (synthetic credential) and open the tenant 'Grade 4S · Synthetic Fractions'.
Submit a 4.NF.A.1 objective whose prompt trips the moderation seam (personal data).
Observe the blocked-by-moderation recovery panel and revise the request (revisesRequestId link) with a clean prompt.
Wait for ready-for-review; choose a variant; open review; approve; publish to the class assignment.
Sign in as the learner (omar.demo@example.test), open /learn, start the assigned run, and submit an attempt.
Reveal the outcome and confirm the feedback shown is the approved copy carried through the bridge (PR #186).
expected: Every step completes with evidence: the block is visible with a category explanation, the revised request reaches ready-for-review with four variants, the teacher's chosen variant is approved and published, the learner sees the assignment, the attempt records, and the reveal shows the approved feedback. Sessions idle-expire after 30 minutes with renewal only on continueSession, so the browser work is batched or re-signed-in per segment.
observableFailure: Any step fails: CSRF rejection on a mutation, provider failure on generation, approval bypass, missing learner assignment, or a reveal that does not match the approved copy. S0 passing is the gate — every learner-side case stays blocked-environment until it passes.
flipCondition: Requires the dev server on http://localhost:3111 with AUTH_PUBLIC_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3111, the scratch PostgreSQL, a browser, and a reachable lesson provider for the generation step; each missing piece is recorded with its exact failure.
